name: De-Gridified Voxels / Spheres GI
definition: A Global Illumination method that represents triangle meshes as collections of free-floating spheres (de-gridified voxels) rather than grid-bound voxels, allowing rotation and translation without re-voxelization.
summary: De-Gridified Voxels / Spheres GI is a global illumination method that converts triangle meshes into free-floating spheres, enabling rotation and translation without re-voxelization.
